T: One good hand. Two full plates.
D: A washed-up one-handed bowler takes a talented Amish man on the road to win a million-dollar tournament in Reno.
P: Serve the mains when Roy and Ishmael hit the road to Reno.
S: Crisp chips under beef and bean chilli, melted cheddar, sour cream

Crisp oven fries smothered in smoky beef and bean chilli and melted cheddar, topped with sour cream, pickled jalapeños and spring onion. Bake 1kg frozen chips at 220C for 25 minutes, turning once. Meanwhile brown 400g beef mince with 1 diced onion, add 2 tsp smoked paprika, 2 tsp ground cumin, 1 tsp chilli powder, 400g tin crushed tomatoes and a drained 400g tin kidney beans, and simmer 20 minutes until thick. Pile the chips into a baking dish, spoon over the chilli, scatter with 150g grated cheddar and grill 3 minutes until melted. Top with 100g sour cream, sliced jalapeños and spring onion.
Amish farm soft pretzels with apple butter
Soft baked pretzels with homemade cinnamon apple butter

Warm, chewy soft pretzels with a deep brown crust and flaky salt, served with spiced apple butter and a hot mustard dip. Divide 500g pizza dough into 8 pieces, roll each into a 50cm rope and twist into pretzels. Bring 2L water and 60g bicarb to a simmer and dip each pretzel for 30 seconds. Lay on a lined tray, brush with 1 beaten egg, sprinkle with sea salt flakes and bake at 220C for 12 minutes until deep brown. For the apple butter, simmer 4 peeled diced apples with 60g brown sugar, 1 tsp cinnamon and 100ml apple juice for 25 minutes and mash smooth. Serve with American mustard.
M: Amish chicken and noodles over mash
Shredded chicken and egg noodles in thick broth, over mashed potato

Tender chicken thighs simmered with thick egg noodles in a rich, peppery broth, spooned over buttery mashed potato with parsley. Simmer 800g chicken thighs in 1.5L chicken stock with 1 diced onion, 2 diced carrots and 2 celery sticks for 35 minutes. Lift out the chicken, shred it and return it to the pot. Add 300g wide egg noodles and simmer 8 minutes until the broth thickens. Season well with salt and plenty of white pepper. Meanwhile boil 1kg peeled potatoes for 20 minutes and mash with 60g butter and 100ml milk. Ladle the chicken and noodles over the mash and scatter with chopped parsley.
W: Sticky molasses pie with a buttery brown sugar crumb top

A wet-bottomed molasses pie under a buttery brown sugar crumble, served warm with lightly whipped cream to cut through the sticky richness. Line a 23cm pie dish with 1 sheet shortcrust pastry. Rub 150g plain flour, 100g brown sugar and 60g cold butter into crumbs. Whisk 150ml molasses, 1 egg and 180ml hot water with 1 tsp bicarb. Pour into the pastry case, then scatter the crumbs evenly over the top. Bake at 200C for 10 minutes, then drop to 180C for 30 minutes until just set with a slight wobble. Cool 30 minutes and serve with 200ml whipped cream.
K: Vanilla ice cream, milk and malted milk powder blended thick

Thick vanilla milkshakes blended with malt powder and ice cream, poured into chilled glasses with whipped cream and a sprinkle of extra malt. Chill 4 tall glasses in the freezer for 15 minutes. Blend 600ml cold full cream milk with 8 scoops vanilla ice cream, 4 tbsp malted milk powder and 1 tsp vanilla extract until thick and smooth. Pour into the cold glasses. Whip 150ml thickened cream to soft peaks, spoon on top and sprinkle each with a little more malt powder. Serve straight away with thick straws.

Add the vegetable stock with the diced onion, the diced carrots and the celery sticks and simmer for 20 minutes.
